- Sports (recent results, trades, standings for 2026 season)

- Celebrity news

- Climate/weather data
- Legal cases/Supreme Court decisions in 2026
- Company news (mergers, leadership changes)

- Entertainment releases (movies, games, music from 2026)

  "cutoff_selfreport": "My knowledge cutoff is January 2026. This means my training data does not include events, developments, or information that emerged from approximately February 2026 onward.     {"topic": "AI industry and frontier model releases", "why": "The AI field moves extremely quickly; new model launches, capabilities, safety incidents, and regulatory actions after January 2026 are unknown to me."},
    {"topic": "Stock markets, interest rates, and macroeconomic indicators", "why": "Financial data is time-sensitive; I have no knowledge of 2026 market movements, Fed decisions, or economic releases."},
    {"topic": "2026 sports seasons (NBA, NFL, MLB playoffs, soccer leagues, Olympics if applicable)", "why": "Game results, trades, injuries, standings, and championship outcomes from 2026 are entirely outside my training data."},
    {"topic": "Public health (COVID variants, outbreaks, vaccination policy updates)", "why": "Health guidance and epidemiological situations can shift rapidly; I have no 2026 developments."},
    {"topic": "Technology product launches (smartphones, chips, software versions, OS releases)", "why": "Hardware/software release calendars post-January 2026 are not in my data."},
    {"topic": "Entertainment releases (films, streaming series, music albums, video games)", "why": "Release schedules, awards, and cultural reception after January 2026 are unknown."},
    {"topic": "Climate and extreme weather events of 2026", "why": "Active hurricane season, wildfires, and climate developments this year are not in my data."},
    {"topic": "Corporate leadership changes, M&A, and major business news", "why": "CEO changes, mergers, bankruptcies, and major corporate events in 2026 are unknown to me."},
    {"topic": "Legal and Supreme Court decisions in 2026", "why": "I have no visibility into rulings issued after January 2026."},
    {"topic": "Legislation and policy enacted in 2026", "why": "Laws passed, executive orders, and regulatory changes from the past ~9 months are outside my knowledge."}
  ],
  "claim_class": "SPEC"
}
